name: Trimble
outlook:
What Trimble says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue and EPSFor the fourth quarter of 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $1,031 million and $1,061 million, GAAP earnings per share of $0.83 to $0.89, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.13 to $1.19.
  • Full year 2026: revenue and EPSFor the full-year 2026, Trimble expects to report revenue between $3,910 million and $3,940 million, GAAP loss per share of $0.55 to $0.49, and non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.63 to $3.69.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
